fixture_format.envelope_digest_rule: SHA-256 of json.dumps({all envelope members except envelope_digest}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False), encoded as 64 lowercase hex characters.
fixture_format.events: JSON array of complete v1 envelope objects, validated in array order.
fixture_format.events_mode_ledgers: Validators maintain sequence ledgers keyed by (source_id, session_ref) across the event list in order. capture_sequence and canonical_sequence must be strictly increasing per key; only accepted events advance a ledger, so a rejected event must not advance either watermark. Distinct source_ids have independent ledgers even when they share one session_ref.
fixture_format.expect: One entry per event/raw_event in the same order. Each entry is exactly {"accepted":true} or {"rejected_code":"NORMATIVE_CODE"}; never both.
fixture_format.id: Stable fixture identifier, unique in this manifest.
fixture_format.mode: "events" uses an events array of envelope objects; "raw" uses a raw_events array of exact JSON strings for duplicate-member cases.
fixture_format.neutral_scope: All values are synthetic neutral references and fixed integers. No provider, collection, market-shaped data, admitted dataset or live path is represented.
fixture_format.p13_behaviour_full_set: Both contract_conformance suites must assert the full manifest file count and iterate every manifest-listed fixture; a suite that runs a subset fails closed in --behaviour mode.
fixture_format.p13_canonicalisation: Escaped and non-ASCII identifier strings are serialized with ensure_ascii=False and sorted compact keys before SHA-256; a duplicate member is detected before digest recomputation and rejected as UNKNOWN_OR_MISSING_MEMBER. The recorded envelope_digest of a duplicate-member raw event is the digest of the equivalent unique-member object, so the duplicate is the sole defect.
fixture_format.p13_enum_types: An unknown string or any non-string JSON value (number, null, object) for quality_state maps to INVALID_QUALITY_STATE, and for continuity_state to INVALID_CONTINUITY_STATE. Missing or duplicate members remain UNKNOWN_OR_MISSING_MEMBER.
fixture_format.p13_integer_boundaries: Required integer fields reject -1, 0 where positivity is required, floats (1.0 and exponent form 1e0 parse to the same float), null and non-integer JSON values with the field's normative code: schema_version -> SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH, capture_sequence -> NON_MONOTONIC_CAPTURE_SEQUENCE, canonical_sequence -> NON_MONOTONIC_CANONICAL_SEQUENCE, receive_utc_ns/receive_monotonic_ns -> INVALID_RECEIVE_TIME, connection_epoch -> INVALID_CONNECTION_EPOCH. provider_sequence and source_timestamp_ns are u64-or-null: null is valid, 0 is valid only for source_timestamp_ns, and out-of-range or non-integer values map to INVALID_PROVIDER_SEQUENCE / INVALID_SOURCE_TIMESTAMP. The u64 maximum itself is valid wherever the field's semantic rule allows it (schema_version still requires the literal 1); max+1 and extremely large integers are out of range. A missing required member is UNKNOWN_OR_MISSING_MEMBER, not a field-code rejection. Each boundary case uses its own source_id so only the targeted field is under test.
fixture_format.p13_ledger_admission: In mode events a structurally valid QUARANTINED envelope offered to the public sequence ledger is rejected with QUARANTINED_NOT_ADMISSIBLE and advances neither watermark; the next admissible envelope with the same starting sequence must be accepted, proving the watermark was absent. Rejected events never advance a ledger in any fixture.
fixture_format.raw_events: JSON array of exact JSON strings, validated in array order without collapsing duplicate members.
fixture_format.raw_mode_duplicate_rule: Duplicate JSON members are detected before digest recomputation and rejected as UNKNOWN_OR_MISSING_MEMBER. For NEG-009 the recorded envelope_digest is the digest of the equivalent unique-member object, making the duplicate member the sole defect.
